description: This file defines static API endpoint mapping for legacy compatibility within an ASP.NET Core web application. It includes methods to register routes related to site assets, input EF source mappings, and throughput setup, all delegating to underlying business logic flows. Additionally, it contains request contract classes used for legacy request payloads.

classes.name: ManageSiteAssetsRequest
classes.description: Legacy request contract for managing site assets, supporting both create and update operations via mode indicator.

classes.name: RemoveSiteAssetRequest
classes.description: Legacy request contract for removing (soft deleting) a site asset, including audit fields.

methods.name: MapLegacyObservedApiEndpoints
methods.description: Registers all legacy/observed API endpoints on the provided route builder.

methods.name: MapSiteAssetsObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Defines route mappings for site asset management, including create/update and remove.

methods.name: MapInputEfSourceMappingObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Defines route mappings for EF source mapping operations, including create, list, and update.

methods.name: MapCalculatedThroughputEquationSetupObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Defines route mappings for throughput calculation setup functions.
